gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-lao-looped: Bold Goldman runs wide and generous, while Noto Sans Lao Looped packs its words into solid blocks. Paragraphs in the sans-serif body feel dense, steady and easy to follow.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Wide, generously spaced letters give Goldman its whole attitude. It handles the loud announcement, while Noto Sans Mandaic, a curvy sans with lowercase rising close to capitals, does the carrying.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-marchen: Noto Sans Marchen stands its small letters up almost capital-sized, with curves ending in clear daylight beneath the wide headings of Goldman. Paragraphs read crisp and open, never crowding.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-meetei-mayek: A towering lowercase marks Goldman out at once. Big lowercase on Goldman meets large lowercase eyes on Noto Sans Meetei Mayek, a plain sans, so both lean toward generous scale.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-mende-kikaku: Wide, loud, unmistakable: Goldman stretches its round forms like open parentheses across the heading. And Noto Sans Mende Kikakui keeps daylight in every curve, so a full page of text stays easy on the eye.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-meroitic: Round forms like open parentheses define Goldman. Beneath it, Noto Sans Meroitic fills its lines with capital-sized lowercase and see-through c openings, a plain sans backing the heading up.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-mono: Noto Sans Mono, a plain sans, spaces every letter apart. Beside the wide, commanding Goldman, its sturdy, large-looking words and open curves make the whole pair feel confidently roomy.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-mro: Noto Sans Mro, a plain sans, packs dense, tall-middled words with wide entrances into each letter. Noto Sans Mro quietly carries the text while Goldman, wide and bold, does the announcing.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-multani: Commanding, wide Goldman takes the lead here. Noto Sans Multani, a plain sans with lofty lowercase and wide-gapped e terminals, follows, and generous openness is what really unites them.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-noto-sans-nag-mundari: Contemporary lowercase meets Goldman head on, wide and sure. Noto Sans Nag Mundari, a plain sans with half-unwrapped curves and lowercase rivaling capitals, keeps a sturdy rhythm line after line.
